name: Copy swaps in the narrator's pauses

source.description: 1 inspected reference film (batch-5, 2026-11-27): the corpus's first narrated film (a 60 s light-canvas reading-app explainer) changes every headline inside a pause of the voice, readable just before the phrase that says it.

technique: In a narrated film every change of on-screen copy (headline, list line, card) happens inside a pause of the voice, never over a word, and the new copy is readable a beat before the phrase that says it. The viewer reads the line, then hears it confirmed, and nothing changes while they listen.
purpose: Keep reading and listening from competing: the viewer reads the new line in the breath, then hears it confirmed, and no copy changes over a spoken word.
visual_behaviour: A headline lane beside a demo. At each pause in the narration the old line fades out, the slot is empty for a moment and the new line fades in a fraction of a second before the phrase that names it; list lines arrive the same way, one per phrase. The demo beside it keeps moving.
mechanics: Take phrase times from the measured narration (word times or voice activity). For each copy change pick the pause before the phrase that names the new copy: old copy fades out 0.17-0.20 s, the slot stays empty 0.07-0.10 s, new copy fades in over 0.13-0.15 s, timed so it is first visible 0.2-0.6 s before the phrase starts (list lines about 0.2 s). Keep the demo beside it moving so the pause is not a frozen frame.

decomposition.timing: Swap about 0.35 s in all. Observed: 11 of 11 swaps in pauses (chance 0.28); swap starts a median 0.60 s (0.01-0.94) before the phrase; first visible 0.27 and 0.58 s before it (strips); list lines 0.21 s before. This voice's pauses: median 0.50 s, max 1.12 s.

parameters.name: lead
parameters.description: new copy first visible before the phrase starts (s)

parameters.name: min_pause
parameters.description: shortest pause that can hold a swap (s)

use_cases: Narrated explainers with a headline lane beside a demo
Lists built one line per phrase
Any copy change in a voiced film
failure_modes: A pause shorter than the swap: start it in the previous pause or shorten the fades
Copy that appears after its phrase reads as a lagging caption
Swaps on a fixed grid instead of measured pauses land over words

implementation.approach: Studio.comp.copySlot(parent, versions) (runtime 1.18.0): versions share one grid cell; swap(tl, i, phraseStart, {words}) fades out 0.18 s, leaves 0.08 s empty and fades in 0.14 s, first visible 0.3 s before the phrase, and warns (api.warnings) when the swap window overlaps a measured spoken word.

priority.note: Highest-value narration finding so far (11 of 11 swaps in pauses against 0.28 chance), but from one film measured with rough dictation; confirm on a second narrated reference or with a Mac whisper re-run.

provenance.observed: All 11 headline swaps fall in voice pauses; the headline at 18.70 s fades out, the slot is empty about 0.1 s and the new one is visible at 19.03 s, 0.27 s before the phrase (19.30 s); the list line at 42.53 s leads its phrase by 0.21 s.
